---
title: "sblrbench"
description: "Reproducible benchmark contracts and frozen development studies for sblr."
---

`sblrbench` provides reusable contracts, validation, metrics, provenance and
reproducible benchmark studies for scalable Bayesian linear regression methods
implemented in `sblr`.

## Available development benchmarks

| Study | Purpose | Development status | Scale | Report |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Study 01 | Separated-locus fine-mapping | Complete structural benchmark | 10 replicates; 40 fits | [Fine-mapping](studies/01_finemapping/separated-development-pilot.qmd) |
| Study 02 | Held-out single-trait prediction | Complete five-replicate development benchmark | 2 architectures; 5 replicates; 40 fits | [Prediction](studies/02_prediction/prediction-development-pilot.qmd) |
| Study 03 | Single-trait parameter estimation | Complete five-replicate development benchmark | 2 architectures; 5 replicates; 40 fits | [Parameter estimation](studies/03_parameter_estimation/parameter-estimation-development-pilot.qmd) |
| Study 04 | Multichain convergence diagnostics | Complete recommendation run plus five-replicate fixed-setting validation | 4 recommendation fits/16 chains; 20 validation fits/80 chains | [Convergence](studies/04_convergence/convergence-development-pilot.qmd) |
| Study 05 | Annotation-informed single-trait models | Interface and maximum-history pilot complete; prespecified convergence stop triggered | No five-replicate benchmark or frozen scientific result capsule | [Development record](docs/dev/study05_annotation_models_run.md) |
| Study 06 v2 | Retained low-rank LD operators | Complete five-replicate development benchmark | 2 architectures; 5 paired replicates; 60 four-chain fits | [Retained low rank](studies/06_ld_operator/retained-low-rank-operator-development-v2.qmd) |

::: {.callout-warning .callout-development}
## Development benchmarks—not final method-performance claims.
These studies validate software workflows, reporting contracts and operational
diagnostics. Their short MCMC settings and limited simulation designs do not
establish universal rankings, calibration or production readiness.
:::

Continue with the [benchmark catalogue](studies/index.qmd), [framework](framework.qmd),
[metric definitions](metrics.qmd), or [reproducibility lifecycle](reproducibility.qmd).
